digest.component_or_area: DC rich-text live integration and inbound differ echo-suppression
propositions: Live DC harness must assert rendered HTML fidelity via ?expand=renderedFields for Markdown-to-wiki conversions (heading/bold/code-macro markup)

State-based echo-safety: a converged DC rich body on the second reconcile pass must compute inbound=0 (no re-push) because the inbound differ treats Jira's echoed wiki form as unchanged when it matches the local body's landed wire form

Both-sides concurrent edit under the settled-conflict policy must keep rebar's body (local-wins) and emit a deduped outbound-field-conflict bridge alert, recording the remote value without silent destruction
Cross-repo contract test must pin InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text back-compatibility so signature/behavior changes fail before breaking agentic-dev-platform imports

Inbound differ must inject the OutboundMapper port and apply codec-aware echo-suppression for description (mirroring the outbound _baseline_form_matches path) to avoid pulling back Jira's wiki echo of Markdown pushes
